The document describes specifications for nitrogen supply pressure regulators.
There are four tags (PCV 1-250-05A, PCV 2-250-05A, PCV 3-250-05A, PCV 4-250-05A) each with specific service details.
All regulators are self-contained and made of carbon steel.
The pressure range for all regulators is between 5 - 8 psi-g.
The maximum operating temperature for all regulators is 550 Deg. F.
The document contains specifications for nitrogen service pressure regulators.
There are two main tags: PCV 5-250-05A and PCV 6-250-05A.
PCV 1-250-05B and PCV 2-250-05B have specifications for a 40 psig system.
All regulators are self-contained with carbon steel bodies and stainless steel diaphragms.
The maximum operating pressure varies from 8 SCFM to 5000 scfh.
The document describes specifications for two pressure regulators in a nitrogen supply system.
Both regulators have the same service, salt tanks level instrument, P&ID number, and body size.
They differ slightly in their operating parameters such as max flow, norm flow, and outlet pressure.
All regulators are made of carbon steel with stainless steel springs and seals.
The specifications include details on material types, dimensions, and purchasing information.
Both regulators have the same design parameters such as body type, size, and material.
The maximum operating pressure varies between the two regulators (40 psig vs 210 psig).
Jorcote on SST is used as the packing or seal material for both regulators.
Jordan is the manufacturer of the regulators with model number MK 60.
The document contains specifications for two types of pressure regulators: one for nitrogen services and another for instrument air services.
Both regulators are self-contained and made of carbon steel with stainless steel diaphragms.
The nitrogen service regulator operates at a maximum pressure of 210 psig, while the instrument air service regulator operates at 170 psig.
The specifications include details on flow rates, operating temperatures, and material compositions.
Purchasing information is provided for both types of regulators, with Jordan as the manufacturer.
The document contains specifications for pressure regulators used in instrument air and nitrogen services.
There are three types of pressure regulators: PCV 202-01, PCV 202-02, PCV 311-01, PCV 311-02, and PCV 221-20A/B.
All regulators have similar specifications such as body type, material, and maximum operating pressure.
The document includes details on the service, P&ID number, location, and flow rates for each regulator.
Manufacturers specified are Jordan with model number MK 60 for all regulators.
